family2_A2_decision_instant.question: eligibility keyed to operative availability alone vs first_readable (= first bar >= max(availability, effective))
family2_A2_decision_instant.ruling: first_readable_decision_utc GOVERNS — the inherited PIT invariant (adoption test b: a decision never reads a row whose effective_time_utc > T) is frozen program semantics; the ledger precomputes exactly this field; availability-only would read a rate before it is in force
family2_A2_decision_instant.score_effect: changes schedule on pre-announcement rows (87 flagged); pinned before any scored run
